purpose: Prospective fixed-contract deployment-fidelity and valid-audio gate for a phase-sensitive source-derived representation. This does not replace or pass the separate preliminary .999/.01 waveform screen.

claim_boundary.allowed: exact-source-derived unquantized FP32 mobile representation of official Kokoro v1.0 for one frozen text/voice/speed/phase-noise contract
forbidden: the previously pinned sherpa disable_complex=True graph
HTP, QNN, NNAPI, GPU, or Vulkan execution

fixed_input_requirements.phase_and_noise: Materialize the official torch.rand/torch.randn_like model inputs from PyTorch CPU seed 20260818 with the exact source memory-format ordering; no ONNX Random* nodes are allowed.

controlled_wrapper_equivalence_gate.reference: official KModel eager with default complex torch.stft/torch.istft and seed 20260818
controlled_wrapper_equivalence_gate.candidate: same loaded model with standard ONNX STFT symbolic, source-equivalent real iSTFT overlap-add, and exact materialized model random inputs

preliminary_waveform_screen_retained_sep.policy: The failure is immutable and must never be relabeled as passed. It is not the deployment-validity gate because final cross-runtime waveforms are explicitly descriptive for this phase-sensitive generator.

phone_phase_tolerant_acoustic_gate.alignment: exact sample count; no post-hoc time shift, resampling, or dynamic time warping
phone_phase_tolerant_acoustic_gate.waveform_metrics: Report cosine, NRMSE, RMSE, maximum error, and SNR descriptively only; they cannot erase the preliminary numerical failure or independently fail this phase-tolerant gate.
phone_phase_tolerant_acoustic_gate.intelligibility: If the already pinned Whisper-small environment/checkpoint is locally practical, report WER against the exact transcript and host/phone hypothesis agreement as supporting evidence only. Do not download or substitute an unpinned ASR model merely to force this optional signal.

benchmark.timed_scope: text frontend, token/style/speed construction, full neural inference, and in-memory float audio assembly
benchmark.memory: VmHWM process-lifetime RSS high-water; not steady live PSS or component-isolated memory
